subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should Crabbox permanently support this dedicated private AWS workspace service and ECS deployment as a core mode?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but code review cannot decide whether the project should own the new API, infrastructure, security boundary, and operations surface over time.

options.title: Sponsor the core mode
options.body: Accept ongoing ownership and merge after removing the release-owned changelog entry and completing final approval.

options.title: Keep reusable primitives only
options.body: Retain generic credential and provider-capability improvements while moving the dedicated deployment and service contract outside core.

options.title: Decline the service surface
options.body: Close the PR if the AWS-specific operational commitment is outside current core priorities.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core mode
recommendation.body: Accept ongoing ownership and merge after removing the release-owned changelog entry and completing final approval.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history identifies steipete as the strongest owner of the AWS, coordinator, Node runtime, and deployment surfaces involved in this product choice.
